name: Responses that say what the results hold
purpose: The response contains the answer, names only links the results hold, names at least one of them, and says plainly when a piece was not done.
record: Forty-four cases (evaluation/response_writing/build_cases.py): forty questions with their gold answer and gold links from the web-search set, and four pieces that were refused or failed. One number: the share of cases passed. The model-backed arm costs a call per case and has no run yet.
disadvantages: Faithfulness and completeness of the words, not tone or concision, which the quality profile names and no case measures yet.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
